Variants.Content: Ancient Oak is the traditional seat of House Oakheart, located in the western reaches of the Reach. The ancient oak forests that give it its name also provide the estate with timber, grazing, hunting and long-term land resources. The western edge of the Reach is connected to both the hinterland of Highgarden and the road to the west, so the castle not only has to manage harvests and vassals, but also needs to keep an eye on passing caravans and news from the border. The oak tree here is both a family symbol and a very practical source of shipbuilding materials, beams and firewood.

Entry Old Oak A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Old Oak They care about grain, wine, orchards, pastures and markets along the Mander River. They also look at whether seeds are left after the grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
